description: This file is a Streamlit web app page for uploading, processing, and managing PDF chapters related to medical textbooks. It handles file uploads, extracts text, generates embeddings, stores data, and displays existing chapters with options for deletion.

classes.name: LangchainPDFProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing PDF files and extracting text chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class managing the creation of text embeddings.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for storing and retrieving embeddings in a local vector database.

methods.name: process_pdf
methods.description: Method to process a PDF file and extract text chunks.

methods.name: batch_embed
methods.description: Method to generate embeddings for a batch of texts asynchronously.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Method to load existing data from storage or vector store.

methods.name: add_embeddings
methods.description: Method to add embeddings and associated chunks to the vector store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Method to save the current state of the vector store.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Method to append new chapter metadata to storage.
